prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in on a roadway in Conroe, Texas. Please state for the record that you consent to this recording.

A: Yes, I consent to the recording.

Q: Can you describe where you were driving and what you were doing just before the impact?

A: I was heading down the main road toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed, so I was already coming to a stop behind a line of cars at a light.

Q: How long had you been stopped before the vehicle behind you hit yours?

A: Only a few seconds. I had my foot on the brake and my car was completely still when I felt the jolt from behind.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle approaching before the collision?

A: Not really. I checked my mirror a moment before stopping, but I didn't notice it closing in. It happened fast.

Q: Did you feel any immediate pain or symptoms at the scene?

A: My neck snapped back and forward, and my lower back felt tight right away. I didn't think much of it at first because I was shaken up.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and was referred to my family doctor for follow-up. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any ongoing symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check my blind spot, and I have a dull ache in my lower back that gets worse after I sit for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been careful to follow my doctor's instructions and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
